description: We are Team Ingabo X, a passionate cohort of innovators based in Kigali, Rwanda. Inspired by the spirit of cosmic guardians, our mission is to leverage NASA's open-source data to build impact-driven solutions for humanity. Combining our skills in software development, data analytics, and creative storytelling, we aim to push the boundaries of technology and space science. We are dedicated to collaboration, critical thinking, and turning complex satellite insights into real-world applications.
